metas.name: The Night Of
metas.description: A college student wakes beside a murdered woman and is swallowed by the justice system. Tight and grim, and every episode tightens the vise.

metas.name: Ripley
metas.description: Steven Zaillian's black-and-white Highsmith adaptation of a con man who murders his way into a rich man's life. Cold, precise and patient.

metas.name: Mare of Easttown
metas.description: A worn-out small-town detective investigates a teenage mother's murder while her own life falls apart. Each episode lands a turn, and the ending is excellent.

metas.name: Happy Valley
metas.description: A Yorkshire police sergeant crosses paths again with the man who destroyed her family. Brutal, smart and very hard to stop watching.

metas.name: The Sinner
metas.description: A young mother stabs a stranger to death on a beach and has no idea why. Each season peels back a buried trauma.

metas.name: Big Little Lies
metas.description: A murder at a school fundraiser in wealthy Monterey, told through the mothers lying to each other. Glossy, cruel and well paced.

metas.name: True Detective
metas.description: Two Louisiana detectives chase a ritualistic killer across 17 years. The first season is a slow-burn crime story with real dread.

metas.name: Malice
metas.description: A charming young man works his way into a wealthy family's holiday home as a tutor, and his real motive slowly comes into focus. It is a con-man revenge thriller about a performance played for real, with dread that builds toward a reckoning.
